An '''HCT-2001 ''Dragonboat''-class Reugeot 905 freighter''' was owned by a [[Unidentified Quarren starship owner|Quarren male]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] was stolen by [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]], and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]&mdash;disguised as [[Rako Hardeen]]&mdash;during their [[Riot at the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|escape]] from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]].
